## Quick rundown of LAB: 

I have a different modelling paradigme: 

1. Full numerical range - normal
2. Strictly positive numerical with decimals - log-transform and normal 
3. Strictly postive and zero heavy - poisson
4. Strictly positive and in [0,1,2,3,4,5,6,...,20] - convert to binary - binomial
5. 0-1: binomial
